FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'Pleased to meet you' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Enchanté
   B. merci
   C. bonjour
   D. bien

2. How do you say 'How do you spell it?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ça va ?
   B. Et toi ?
   C. Ça s'écrit comment ?
   D. Je m'appelle Amina.

3. How do you say 'the grandfather' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le garçon
   B. l'enfant
   C. le frère
   D. le grand-père

4. How do you say 'the boy' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la sœur
   B. le garçon
   C. la mère
   D. le père

5. How do you say 'Where is ... ?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le livre
   B. le salon
   C. Où est ... ?
   D. derrière

6. How do you say 'the shower' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la table
   B. la télé
   C. la douche
   D. le sac

7. How do you say 'Monday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. vendredi
   B. jeudi
   C. mardi
   D. lundi

8. How do you say 'Thursday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. vendredi
   B. jeudi
   C. mercredi
   D. lundi

9. How do you write the number 30 in French? (1 mark)
   A. treize
   B. huit
   C. douze
   D. trente

10. How do you write the number 7 in French? (1 mark)
   A. dix
   B. dix-huit
   C. sept
   D. treize

11. How do you write the number 8 in French? (1 mark)
   A. dix-neuf
   B. vingt-cinq
   C. douze
   D. huit

12. How do you say the month 'May' in French? (1 mark)
   A. juillet
   B. avril
   C. mai
   D. septembre

13. What is the plural of gâteau? (1 mark)
   A. gâteau
   B. gâteaus
   C. gâteaues
   D. gâteaux

14. How do you say 'fruits' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la tomate
   B. le poisson
   C. le lait
   D. les fruits

15. How do you say 'long' in French? (1 mark)
   A. grand
   B. long
   C. noir
   D. court

16. How do you say 'the neck' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les yeux
   B. la tête
   C. le cou
   D. le ventre

17. How do you say 'The weather is nice.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il pleut.
   B. Il fait beau.
   C. Il fait froid.
   D. Il y a des nuages.

18. How do you say 'It is windy.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a du vent.
   B. Il y a des nuages.
   C. Il gèle.
   D. Il fait beau.

19. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'key'? (1 mark)
   A. clé
   B. cé
   C. cle
   D. clè

20. How do you say 'next to' in French? (1 mark)
   A. tout droit
   B. à droite
   C. à côté de
   D. à gauche

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into French: 'She has long hair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Write the French words for: the head, black, the foot (3 marks) (3 marks)

23. Translate into French: 'My name is Njeri.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

24. Write a small menu of four foods in French. (4 marks) (4 marks)

25. Write three sentences in French about what you eat in a day. (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Complete the dialogue with words from the bank: ______ ! Je ______ Amina. Et toi ? (bank: Bonjour, m'appelle) (2 marks) (2 marks)

27. Write the French words for: Pleased to meet you, Mrs, Madam, thank you (3 marks) (3 marks)

28. Translate into French: 'There is a cake and there are balloons.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

29. Translate into French: 'The fridge is in the kitchen.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

30. Translate into French: 'Put the book on the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Enchanté
   Pleased to meet you in French is Enchanté.

2. C — Ça s'écrit comment ?
   How do you spell it? in French is Ça s'écrit comment ?.

3. D — le grand-père
   the grandfather in French is le grand-père.

4. B — le garçon
   the boy in French is le garçon.

5. C — Où est ... ?
   Where is ... ? in French is Où est ... ?.

6. C — la douche
   the shower in French is la douche.

7. D — lundi
   Monday in French is lundi.

8. B — jeudi
   Thursday in French is jeudi.

9. D — trente
   30 in French is trente.

10. C — sept
   7 in French is sept.

11. D — huit
   8 in French is huit.

12. C — mai
   May in French is mai.

13. D — gâteaux
   Words ending in eau add x.

14. D — les fruits
   fruits in French is les fruits.

15. B — long
   long in French is long.

16. C — le cou
   the neck in French is le cou.

17. B — Il fait beau.
   The weather is nice. in French is Il fait beau..

18. A — Il y a du vent.
   It is windy. in French is Il y a du vent..

19. A — clé
   The correct spelling is clé, with its accents.

20. C — à côté de
   next to in French is à côté de.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Elle a les cheveux longs.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: la tête, noir, le pied
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: Je m'appelle Njeri.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: le riz, les haricots, le poisson, une banane
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct food.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le matin, je mange du pain. À midi, je mange du riz. Le soir, je mange du poisson.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: Bonjour ! Je m'appelle Amina. Et toi ?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Enchanté, Madame, merci
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 4 marks in total.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le frigo est dans la cuisine.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mets le livre sur la table.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.
